_comment_legacy_settings: Fresh config omits ignored Blackhole timing/cut controls. Existing hand-edited compactAfterPresets definitions remain preserved by explicit saves as compatibility data; they never control native Pi budgets.
_notes: v2 config surface:
compaction (auto|manual|off) — Blackhole summary participation; Pi owns all trigger timing
compactionEngine (blackhole|pi-default) — who handles it
compactionSummaryMode (default|append) — replace one summary or freeze auto-compaction segments
showPreCompactionMessage (true|false) — display-only copy of the newest dropped answer, rendered under the compaction card and never sent to the model
Native timing/cut settings belong in Pi compaction.enabled/reserveTokens/keepRecentTokens, not this file
recallResponseMaxChars (default 48000, 0=unbounded) — cap on a single recall tool / /blackhole-recall response; per-entry and per-line shares are derived from it
observationsPoolMaxTokens / reflectionsPoolMaxTokens — rendered-line caps including IDs and separators; headings/footer extra; source history retained
append rebase — pressure plus useful saving at existing compactions; cadence unchanged
sessionFallback (true|false) — if false, skip session model as last-resort fallback
fullFoldAlways (true|false) — treat every compaction as a full-fold boundary so early reflections/drops survive the first compaction
statusBar (true|false) — O/P memory gauges, Pi-owned context/unknown-native-budget label, worker events
showWorkerNotifications (true|false) — routine observer/reflector/dropper progress toasts; false leaves warnings, errors and command output visible
dropperPressureThreshold (0-1, default 0.70) — fraction of observationsPoolMaxTokens where dropper fires without new data (1 disables)
dropperPoolFullnessThreshold (0-1, default 0.10) — minimum pool fullness before the dropper may run at all; stops it churning a nearly empty pool
providerIdleTimeoutMs (ms, 0=disabled, unset=inherit pi default) — body-idle timeout for background provider streams

workerAttemptTimeoutMs (ms, 0/unset=disabled, max 2147483647) — hard elapsed deadline per worker/model attempt; a configured candidate's timeout engages its cooldown + the next fallback; the session fallback is tried once per stage, with no cooldown

cacheRetention (none|short|long, unset=inherit pi's effective setting) — prompt-cache retention for the observer/reflector/dropper streams; left unset here on purpose, since pinning "short" downgrades a host whose effective setting is longer. "long" is opt-in, and adapters that lack it ignore the value
Legacy controls remain readable/diagnosed, never editable Pi budgets; new scaffold and explicit saves omit them
Backward compat: old keys (overrideDefaultCompaction, noAutoCompact, passive)
are read-compatible and may map to canonical summary/memory keys in memory; reading never rewrites their files. Do not bulk-delete aliases or active worker/debug settings.
Env overrides:
PI_BLACKHOLE_PASSIVE=1  → compaction:off + memory:false
PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACTION  → override compaction setting
PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACTION_ENGINE → override compactionEngine setting
PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACTION_SUMMARY_MODE → override compactionSummaryMode setting
PI_BLACKHOLE_REFLECTIONS_POOL_MAX_TOKENS → override reflection output budget
PI_BLACKHOLE_CACHE_RETENTION → override worker prompt-cache retention (none|short|long)
PI_BLACKHOLE_SHOW_WORKER_NOTIFICATIONS → override routine worker progress toasts
PI_BLACKHOLE_RECALL_RESPONSE_MAX_CHARS → override the recall response cap
